title: The Kindling Primer
summary: A first primer on lighting a small flame from qi and holding it in the hand; it teaches the sparks and flares every fire student starts with.

title: A Handbook of Steady Flame
summary: A handbook on keeping a flame at one size for a long time so that fire output stays even and costs little qi.

title: The Ember Keeper's Workbook
summary: A workbook on banking embers of qi under the skin so that a fire student carries ready heat without draining the reserve.

title: The Warm Hand Drill-Book
summary: A drill-book on spreading soft heat through the hands to ease cold limbs and small hurts and to steady a friend in shock.

title: A Primer of Thrown Fire
summary: A primer on throwing small fire from the hand in a straight line or an arc and keeping the throw accurate.

title: The Heat-Reading Handbook
summary: A handbook on feeling warmth in people and objects so that a student can find a body behind a screen or a hidden coal.

title: The Cinder Guard Primer
summary: A primer on wrapping the body in thin fire qi so that blows are scorched aside and the student is not burned by their own flame.

title: A Treatise on Breath and Fire
summary: A treatise on drawing heat up from the belly with each breath and spending it in short strong bursts of flame.

title: The Spark Step Workbook
summary: A workbook on using small bursts of fire qi beneath the heels to quicken a step and turn a fall into a roll.

title: The Hot Fist Drill-Book
summary: A drill-book on wrapping the fist and forearm in fire qi so that a plain punch or elbow leaves a burn behind.
